+interface Group {

+
+const MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH = 64 * 1024
+
+const safePattern: SafePattern = (pattern: unknown, flags: string): RegExp | null => {
+  if (typeof pattern != "string" || pattern.length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH) return null
+
+  const groups: Group[] = [{alternation: false, quantified: false}]
+  let inClass = false
+  let closedGroup: Group | undefined
+

+    const char = pattern[i]
+
+    if (char === "\\") {
+      const next = pattern[++i]
+      if (!inClass && (next === "k" || (next >= "1" && next <= "9"))) return null
+      closedGroup = undefined
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (inClass) {
+      if (char === "]") inClass = false
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (char === "[") {
+      inClass = true
+      closedGroup = undefined
+      continue
+    }

+      groups.push({alternation: false, quantified: false})
+      closedGroup = undefined
+      continue
+    }
+

+      if (groups.length === 1) return null
+      closedGroup = groups.pop()
+      const parent = groups[groups.length - 1]
+      parent.alternation ||= closedGroup.alternation
+      parent.quantified ||= closedGroup.quantified
+      continue
+    }
+

+      groups[groups.length - 1].alternation = true
+      closedGroup = undefined
+      continue
+    }

+    if (char === "{") {

+      if (!quantifier) {
+        closedGroup = undefined
+        continue
+      }
